name: Brisk Morning Walk
instructions: Maintain an upright posture, swing arms naturally, and walk briskly at a pace where you can talk but not sing.

name: Interval Jogging & Walk
instructions: Alternate between 2 minutes of moderate jogging and 1 minute of active recovery walking.

name: Surya Namaskar (Sun Salutations)
instructions: Flow through 6-8 cycles of 12 classic asanas coordinating breath with each movement.

name: Full Body Mobility & Joint Awakening
instructions: Gentle neck rolls, shoulder circles, cat-cow arches, hip openers, and ankle rotations.

name: Bodyweight Squats & Core Activation
instructions: 3 sets of 12 controlled air squats, followed by 30-second forearm planks and glute bridges.

name: Evening Deep Stretch & De-Stress
instructions: Hold gentle hamstring stretches, pigeon pose, child's pose, and supine spinal twists for 45 seconds each.

name: Upper Body Light Dumbbell / Water Bottle Circuit
instructions: Light bicep curls, overhead shoulder press, lateral raises, and bent-over rows with 1-2kg weights or water bottles.

name: Desk Worker Ergonomic Reset
instructions: Seated spinal twist, wrist stretches, chin tucks, and standing calf raises to counteract prolonged sitting.
